snippet.title: My Patriot Supply
snippet.description:
In 2008, My Patriot Supply was born with a passion for helping Americans achieve independence through preparedness and self-reliance. As active participants in the preparedness lifestyle, we understand today’s complex concerns and challenges that come with getting prepared, because we’ve been through it. 

We believe that true patriotism is not the expectation that others will care for your needs but that freedom comes from attaining a certain level of self-reliance. snippet.title: SolarSculpt
snippet.description:
Solar energy products have revolutionized the way we power our homes, businesses, and outdoor adventures. Solar panels capture sunlight and convert it into clean, renewable electricity, significantly reducing utility bills and carbon footprints. Modern panels boast high-efficiency cells and durable frames, making them ideal for rooftops, ground mounts, or portable setups. Solar generators combine battery storage with inverters, providing reliable backup power during outages or off-grid excursions. These all-in-one units are quiet, maintenance-free, and easy to recharge using sunlight or AC outlets. 
At SolarSculpt, we dive deep into each of these technologies—testing panels in real-world conditions, comparing generator runtimes, and breaking down inverter setups step by step. If you’re ready to take control of your energy future, subscribe to SolarSculpt, hit the notification bell, and join our community of solar enthusiasts.

snippet.title: Off Grid with Jay and Jen
snippet.description:
Help us reach 100K subscribers in 2026– hit that subscribe button and follow our off-grid journey!
We’re Jay and Jen, two regular folks building a dream — debt-free — on 15 remote, wooded acres in Northern Michigan. From our main cabin to a pole barn, a solar/water system, and mini cabins in the woods, we’ve built it all with our own hands and a whole lot of determination.

Solar can be easy. I call it Simply Complicated. Once it's explained in a simple way, it's easy to understand and use it. 

I aim to help people save money, be self-reliant, and have all the power they need anywhere they go.

My goals are to create, teach, and help.
